# GroundApp

> GroundApp is a breathwork app for iPhone and Apple Watch, created by Collin Chartier. Check in with Bodie and practise guided breathing. Free to download, with a free tier and optional Premium. GroundApp is coaching and education, not medical or mental health treatment. Website: https://groundapp.live/

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/groundapp-breathwork/id6760352779
- Creator: [Collin Chartier](https://collinchartier.com/), an endurance athlete, coach and creator
- Requires iOS 17 or later. The Apple Watch app requires watchOS 11 or later.
- Create an account when you start, with Apple, Google or email. You can delete it in Settings.

## Pricing

- Free to download, with a free tier and optional Premium. No fixed catalog or free-technique count is promised.
- Published US Premium pricing is $69.99 a year or $6.99 a month. The store confirms local price, inclusions and any eligible trial before purchase. Apple subscriptions renew unless cancelled through Apple.

## Features

- Breathing techniques with practice guides; current free inclusions are shown in the app
- Check in with Bodie: name how you feel and see a suggested session, not a diagnosis or a measured nervous-system state
- Advanced O2 and CO2 tables for breath-hold training. Dry land only. Never in or near water.
- Guided sessions in Collin's voice, with ambient sound and haptic cues (Premium)
- Guided meditations
- Guided sessions use an AI model of Collin's voice, trained on his recordings; haptic-only mode is available
- Live heart rate and HRV from a Bluetooth heart rate monitor or a Whoop or Garmin broadcasting heart rate
- Apple Health, plus Whoop, Garmin, Oura and COROS through Apple Health
- Apple Watch app
- Streaks and session history. Sample progress screens are not user outcomes.
- Current free inclusions and Premium features are shown in the app before purchase.

- [Created by Collin Chartier](https://groundapp.live/#story): Collin created and developed GroundApp. Read [why he built it](https://groundapp.live/blog/why-i-built-groundapp/) or [his story](https://collinchartier.com/#about). His homepage is https://collinchartier.com/.

- [Nervous system regulation, without the promises](https://groundapp.live/blog/nervous-system-regulation-explained/): Stress and breathing without self-diagnosis or treatment promises
- [The science of breathwork, and its limits](https://groundapp.live/blog/science-of-breathwork/): Breathing research, HRV and the limits of applying study findings to an app
- [Where breathwork tech is going](https://groundapp.live/blog/future-of-breathwork-tech/): Present app capabilities and Collin's views on privacy and human care
- [Breathing patterns for everyday anxious moments](https://groundapp.live/blog/breathing-techniques-for-anxiety/): Five patterns with comfort guidance, not a treatment guide

## Free game

- [Bodie's Breath Run](https://groundapp.live/play): a free browser game with finger and keyboard controls, screen shields, jumps and a noncompetitive ribbon ride. Breathe normally. No maximal-hold mode, physiological score or dive challenge. Game records use a new browser-only namespace, separate from the removed breath-hold records.

## Use Cases

- Calming down in a stressful moment
- Winding down for sleep
- Focus and composure before a performance, presentation or competition
- Energy in the morning or before training
- Building a daily breathwork habit

## Safety and scope

- This is coaching and education, not medical or mental health treatment.
- Advanced breath-hold tables: Dry land only. Never in or near water.
- Wearable readings inform suggestions. They are not a medical assessment.
